description: Schedule social posts to any of 30+ providers via a running postiz instance (hosted at api.postiz.com or self-hosted). Use this skill whenever someone wants to post, schedule, or publish a draft to LinkedIn, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Discord, Slack, or any non-Twitter social channel. ALWAYS chain content-atomizer first for platform-specific copy — this skill is a distribution layer only, it does not rewrite copy. For Twitter/X threads, use typefully instead (better thread UX). Triggers: "post to linkedin", "post to reddit", "post to bluesky", "post to mastodon", "post to threads", "schedule via postiz".
